211: 			JCTree resolvedMethodCall = resolution.get(methodCall);
212: 			if (resolvedMethodCall == null || resolvedMethodCall.type == null) return;
213: 			if (!suppressBaseMethods && !(resolvedMethodCall.type instanceof ErrorType)) return;
214: 			
215: 			JCTree resolvedReceiver = resolution.get(receiver);
216: 			if (resolvedReceiver == null || resolvedReceiver.type == null) return;
217: 			Type receiverType = resolvedReceiver.type;
218: 			
219: 			// Skip static method access
220: 			Symbol sym = null;
221: 			if (resolvedReceiver instanceof JCIdent) {
222: 				sym = ((JCIdent) resolvedReceiver).sym;
223: 			} else if (resolvedReceiver instanceof JCFieldAccess) {
224: 				sym = ((JCFieldAccess) resolvedReceiver).sym;
225: 			}
226: 			if (sym instanceof ClassSymbol) return;
227: 			
228: 			Types types = Types.instance(annotationNode.getContext());
229: 			for (Extension extension : extensions) {
230: 				TypeSymbol extensionProvider = extension.extensionProvider;
231: 				if (surroundingTypeSymbol == extensionProvider) continue;
232: 				for (MethodSymbol extensionMethod : extension.extensionMethods) {
233: 					if (!methodName.equals(extensionMethod.name.toString())) continue;
234: 					Type extensionMethodType = extensionMethod.type;
235: 					if (!MethodType.class.isInstance(extensionMethodType) && !ForAll.class.isInstance(extensionMethodType)) continue;
236: 					Type firstArgType = types.erasure(extensionMethodType.asMethodType().argtypes.get(0));
237: 					if (!types.isAssignable(receiverType, firstArgType)) continue;
238: 					methodCall.args = methodCall.args.prepend(receiver);
239: 					methodCall.meth = chainDotsString(annotationNode, extensionProvider.toString() + "." + methodName);

241: 					return;
242: 				}
243: 			}
244: 		}

246: 		private String methodNameOf(final JCMethodInvocation methodCall) {
247: 			if (methodCall.meth instanceof JCIdent) {
248: 				return ((JCIdent) methodCall.meth).name.toString();
249: 			} else {
250: 				return ((JCFieldAccess) methodCall.meth).name.toString();
251: 			}
252: 		}

256: 				return annotationNode.getTreeMaker().Ident(annotationNode.toName("this"));
257: 			} else {
258: 				return ((JCFieldAccess) methodCall.meth).selected;
259: 			}
